player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Your symbol is '{symbol}'.
The goal is to avoid getting three in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally).
If you make three in a row, you LOSE.
Submit your move using the format '[4]' to place your symbol in cell 4.
As Player {player_id}, you are '{symbol}' and your opponent is '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopego sa go sutisa se se seng molaong. Dirisa '[cell]'.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Intasetiki ya sele e e sa siamang.

game_action.placed: Mmoki {player_id} o belegetswe semelo sa gagwe ({symbol}) mo seleng {cell}.

outcome.loss: Motshameki {player_id} o latlhegelwa ke motshameko ka go fetsa mola!
outcome.draw: Ga go ope yo o latlhegileng.
